mensagens.input: Dale and Liz are each making their own spaghetti sauce, and are using different amounts of ground beef to make it. If you wanted your sauce to have more ground beef, whose sauce should you choose? Use the number line to find out.
Dale is using 10/9 pounds of ground beef.
Liz is using exactly 1 pound of ground beef.
-----,Sauce made by Dale.,Sauce made by Liz.,Both will have same amount of ground beef.
